relations.condition: Same request order, sequence-length generation, CP partition and causal contract; preserve local/global and target/draft epoch boundaries.
relations.rule: Remove existing batch-cache-hit dead producers first, then share certified identical generations before charging the retained five-task fusion. relations.condition: Only index-source sites have a same-layer QLI edge. Valid split preserves native masks and arithmetic.
relations.rule: Do not add hidden QLI wait to eliminated QLI work. Recompute readiness after faster index selection, and charge partial state and any layout/metadata work.

relations.condition: Certify physical slot ownership, old predecessor readiness and retained state visibility. Fused completion includes its ring write tail.
relations.rule: Charge the same old update and zero work once. Compare one fused launch against the split variant with earlier RMS. Compact/deferred commit compete for ring writes, and unchanged tuple allocation can retain the old page size.

relations.condition: Original full-hidden readers must all be satisfied by owner-local branches and typed delivery. Projection rounding depends on shape.
relations.rule: Each layer has one raw input gather credit. C2 joined FP32 GEMM is a separate failed precision gate. If old-M fallback is selected, only the transport delta remains before scratch and pack costs.

relations.condition: Both 910C W8A8 projections consume the same rounded QR and quantizer. Joined N changes tiling and output pitch.
relations.rule: Count the second quantization once. Shared prepared input retains original two outputs. A joined or grouped producer must preserve output-specific precision and price any RoPE-driven copies.

relations.condition: Padded selector is the same current prefix, while query choice and rejected counts remain late. Nonpadded uses the late selector.
relations.rule: Compare all-checkpoint packet with per-checkpoint SWA co-pack as alternatives. Keep the local feature gather. Count earlier main projection as scheduling, and price any work or precision change under a different M separately.

relations.condition: Same terminal raw and normalized generations. Raw reader and rank order determine whether the narrow gather applies.
relations.rule: One raw-to-collapsed traffic delta. Local norm and local collapse each remove their own duplicated row work. Count a removed Post plane only with W02 and remove selected rows only once.

relations.condition: The pinned verifier reads raw draft IDs before cleanup. Previous-owner maps can be shared while branch participation differs.
relations.rule: A single downstream clamp absorbs the earlier -1 cleanup only after the raw gather. A two-output early writer must preserve raw drafts and charge its removed gather, ID overlay and cleanup boundaries once.

relations.condition: Use the same previous-owner generation. Separately check count-copy, scheduled-count and position readiness.
relations.rule: Count seed work and remap work separately. Each remap variant replaces the same snapshot chain. Price only the position/seq work the chosen variant absorbs and keep the existing slot kernel as baseline.

relations.condition: Same target/bonus value generation, score outputs truly dead under the processor-aware summary protocol.
relations.rule: Rebuild the working-score DAG for the strongest plan; do not add weaker-plan byte savings.

relations.condition: Native numerical equivalence class and parameter generation match.
relations.rule: Whole-step hits avoid W2; a native miss still needs the full-width weight plane. Price one miss schedule and real same-step co-occurrence. The measured compact mixed path has a reassembly penalty. A common epilogue changes the residual add/selection cost for both branches.

relations.condition: Cache ownership must follow score/weight ownership.
relations.rule: A replicated cache follows existing one-gather protocol; a sharded cache changes capacity and per-step collectives. These are distinct costed variants.

relations.condition: Every committed real predecessor must have an exact result or execute the original fallback.
relations.rule: Extra candidate work can remove some dependency waits; it can also slow Cube/HBM contention. Five old GEMM calls are not a universal lower bound.

relations.condition: History/request/slot generations differ from immutable parameter/table generations.
relations.rule: Sharing pointers or shapes does not authorize reuse; preserve update, rollback, retirement and cancellation.

relations.condition: Readiness, workspace and shared Cube/vector/HBM/host-UVA/collective resources.
relations.rule: Overlap may hide a producer saving already outside the critical path. Re-schedule the joint DAG instead of adding wait intervals and kernel-time savings.

relations.condition: Same layer/sublayer/token output with its complete reader set.
relations.rule: One removed HC write cannot be counted in three regions; side outputs survive separately.

relations.condition: Pinned current native implementation is selected.
relations.rule: Treat existing fused work as baseline. Only newly removed boundaries, work or improved scheduling are incremental.

relations.condition: Keep source generation and graph event ordering. Split retirement by the actual bank ownership and surviving consumer spans.
relations.rule: Bank retirement changes dependencies, while the helper changes producer work. Recompute one critical path after both changes. Extra banks trade capacity for same-role overlap and must be tied to captured addresses.

relations.condition: Same direct dense arithmetic, unchanged weight generation, with an explicit local HBM/on-chip residency boundary.
relations.rule: Price distinct required weights once in the joint window. Full-vocabulary row pruning retains the head matrix. A remaining direct W2 miss retains the W2 matrix.
